snapshot_note: Multi-milestone parity & hardening updates across native SDB codecs (local_axes_matrix, fys != fy, project_info, grids), concrete beam M2 (as_side) & EC3 10-shape V3/multi-axis design, frame tc_limits span axial equilibrium & modal LinearHistory continuation, and OAPI cCableObj / cDatabaseTables facades (405 tests across 44 suites, 64/64 reference checks). status_legend.implemented-tested: Source implementation exists and a relevant repository test or fixture workflow is present; this status does not mean the current test run passed.
status_legend.implemented-partial: Some behavior exists, with documented scope limits, approximations, or incomplete end-to-end evidence.
status_legend.unsupported: Explicitly rejected, absent from dispatch, or represented only as data without a corresponding implementation.
status_legend.unknown: Source evidence is insufficient to claim behavior; needs comparison with SAP2000 v19 or an authoritative manual/example.

acceptance_checklist: Freeze a fixture manifest with hashes, SAP2000 v19 provenance, units, expected tables, expected outputs, and explicit tolerances; distinguish vendor references from synthetic hand-built checks.
For each imported SDB/S2K fixture, compare imported object counts and critical assignments to vendor tables; fail or report omitted tables/columns before solving.
Round-trip supported S2K tables and compare normalized tables; test the native SDB reader separately. Do not treat private SDB writer output as native-vendor interchange.

Validate solver cases in order: single frame loads/releases/offsets; multi-axis local/global loads; shell membrane/plate/shell; link linear behavior; modal, buckling, response spectrum, Newmark history; then P-Delta. Unsupported case types and unimplemented loads must return explicit errors.

Add negative fixtures proving solids, unsupported nonlinear link families/combinations, cables/tension-only members, unsupported coordinate-system forms, higher-order areas, and unsupported dynamic cases reject rather than produce plausible results.
Validate constraint definitions separately for every enum type; implement exact Rod, Beam, and Line behavior or reject instead of using generic equal DOFs.

For steel design, validate AISC LRFD/ASD and EC3 hand examples by section family; cover local V2/V3 shear, torsion, axial plus biaxial bending, slender elements, buckling, unbraced lengths, and invalid section/material/code combinations.
For concrete design, validate ACI/EC2 beam and column examples including both shear axes, biaxial bending, reinforcement layout, column slenderness, and status handling against vendor outputs.

Audit the API one method at a time against version-matched CSI OAPI type-library metadata/object browser/API help, with contract tests for names, defaults, return codes, mutation invalidation, units, error propagation, and unsupported methods.
Exercise each GUI workflow end to end: create/open/save, edit model, assign loads, solve, inspect diagrams/results/tables, design, and show clear import/analysis/design errors.
